<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/footer-split.ts -->
<!--
  A footer with more than links. Axes: layout (stats: the brand with three figures and a sitemap link over the
  link groups as cards; points, links, newsletter, contacts, channels: a split beside a picture with the brand
  and four points, the brand and small link columns, a newsletter card and link columns, the contacts and two
  actions, or the community channels and figures), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { FooterExtras, FooterSplitLabels } from "./footer-split.types";
  import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type FooterSplitProps = {
    id?: string;
    label: string;
    brand: string;
    tagline: string;
    copyright: string;
    groups: MegaGroup[];
    extras: FooterExtras;
    labels: FooterSplitLabels;
    layout?: "stats" | "points" | "links" | "newsletter" | "contacts" | "channels";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import FooterBrand from "../components/footer-brand.svelte";
  import FooterChannels from "../components/footer-channels.svelte";
  import FooterContacts from "../components/footer-contacts.svelte";
  import FooterFigures from "../components/footer-figures.svelte";
  import FooterGroupCards from "../components/footer-group-cards.svelte";
  import FooterLinkColumns from "../components/footer-link-columns.svelte";
  import FooterPoints from "../components/footer-points.svelte";
  import FooterSignupCard from "../components/footer-signup-card.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id = "footer",
    label,
    brand,
    tagline,
    copyright,
    groups,
    extras,
    labels,
    layout = "stats",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FooterSplitProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="footer"
  class={cn("border-t border-border", (((tone as string) === "muted") ? "bg-muted" : ""))}
  data-testid="footer-split"
  data-layout={layout}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "py-12")} data-slot="container">
    {#if ((layout as string) === "stats")}
      <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
        <Group gap="6" align="start" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
          <Stack gap="6" align="start">
            <FooterBrand brand={brand} tagline={tagline} />
            <FooterFigures extras={extras} />
          </Stack>
          <Link href="#/sitemap" size="sm" data-testid="footer-sitemap">
            <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
            {labels.sitemap}
          </Link>
        </Group>
        <FooterGroupCards label={label} groups={groups} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel} />
        <Box class="border-t border-border pt-6">
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {copyright}
          </Text>
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    {:else}
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-8 lg:grid-cols-2">
        {#if ((mediaSide as string) === "start")}
          <MediaFrame alt={brand} ratio="4/3" />
        {/if}
        <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
          {#if (((layout as string) === "points") || ((layout as string) === "links"))}
            <FooterBrand brand={brand} tagline={tagline} />
          {:else}
            <Stack gap="2" align="start">
              <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
                {(((layout as string) === "newsletter") ? labels.loopTitle : (((layout as string) === "channels") ? labels.joinTitle : labels.title))}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {(((layout as string) === "newsletter") ? labels.loopText : (((layout as string) === "channels") ? labels.joinText : labels.text))}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          {/if}
          {#if ((layout as string) === "points")}
            <FooterPoints extras={extras} title={labels.points} />
          {/if}
          {#if ((layout as string) === "newsletter")}
            <FooterSignupCard id={id} labels={labels} />
          {/if}
          {#if (((layout as string) === "links") || ((layout as string) === "newsletter"))}
            <FooterLinkColumns label={label} groups={groups} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel} />
          {/if}
          {#if ((layout as string) === "contacts")}
            <FooterContacts extras={extras} />
            <ActionGroup primary={labels.cta} primaryHref="#/contact" secondary={labels.secondary} secondaryHref="#/work" />
          {/if}
          {#if ((layout as string) === "channels")}
            <FooterChannels extras={extras} />
            <FooterFigures extras={extras} />
          {/if}
          <Box class="border-t border-border pt-6">
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {copyright}
            </Text>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
        {#if ((mediaSide as string) !== "start")}
          <MediaFrame alt={brand} ratio="4/3" />
        {/if}
      </Box>
    {/if}
  </Container>
</Block>
